claims.text: Commonwealth Games 2010 concluded in Delhi amidst widespread corruption allegations
Suresh Kalmadi was arrested by CBI on April 25, 2011 for alleged irregularities in Games contracts
Kalmadi was dismissed from the Indian National Congress party on April 26, 2011
Kalmadi was granted bail on August 25, 2011 after 4 months in custody

outcome.summary: Suresh Kalmadi, chairman of the Commonwealth Games organizing committee, was arrested in April 2011 on corruption charges related to Games contracts. He was dismissed from the Congress party and spent 4 months in custody before being granted bail. The CBI filed charges against him and others for criminal conspiracy and cheating.

title: Commonwealth Games 2010 corruption scandal
trigger: The Commonwealth Games 2010 organizing committee, headed by Suresh Kalmadi, was accused of widespread corruption and mismanagement in awarding contracts, leading to his dismissal and arrest.
